          A focus game prototype

          Welcome, Mayor

          Your town has seen better days. Bring it back to life one focus session at a time.

          GGold pays for itResidents and shops pay taxes, and a happy town pays more. Spend gold on buildings, upgrades and town staff.
          FFocus unlocks itPut your phone away and focus. You earn play time, gold and XP, and your builder works on the big projects.
          PPlay time is your breakEvery 6 minutes of focus earns 1 minute of play. In play you build, decorate and run your town. You start with 5 minutes.
